designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system embodies high-throughput infrastructure engineering, mission-critical stability, and precision telemetry. Tailored for infrastructure engineers, ML platform architects, and enterprise DevOps teams deploying distributed AI workloads, it balances industrial-grade density with razor-sharp modern aesthetics.

The visual style merges structured Enterprise Brutalism—defined by data-dense grids, precise dividers, and monospaced diagnostic readouts—with subtle Dark-Glassmorphism and electro-luminescent telemetry accents. The interface feels like a mission control cockpit for cluster computing: deep void obsidian backgrounds, surgical hierarchy, muted container boundaries, and calculated neon signals indicating system health, throughput spikes, and GPU orchestration states.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built around a flexible 12-column system optimized for dashboard density, telemetry sidecars, and split-screen code debugging.

### Grid & Density Rules
- **Desktop (>= 1280px)**: 12-column layout with 24px margins and 16px gutters. Maximizes monitor horizontal footprint for side-by-side Grafana-style charts, inference traces, and node maps.
- **Tablet (768px - 1279px)**: 8-column layout with 20px margins and 16px gutters. Auxiliary panels collapse into sliding drawers or expandable tab sheets.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column layout with 16px margins and 12px gutters. Telemetry shifts from parallel charts to stacked, priority-driven health cards.
- **Rhythm**: All paddings, row heights, and layout gaps adhere strictly to a 4px base increment (`0.25rem`), prioritizing dense vertical economy without crowding critical diagnostic metrics.

## Elevation & Depth

This system avoids heavy, diffused dropshadows, replacing them with layered obsidian planes, perimeter border gradients, and reactive back-glows.

- **Level 0 (Canvas)**: Raw background (`#0A0D14`), flat surface with no borders.
- **Level 1 (Sub-Panels & Base Cards)**: Surface `#0F1422` with a 1px solid border in `#1E293B`. No shadow.
- **Level 2 (Active Containers & Modals)**: Surface `rgba(15, 20, 34, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`. Outlined with a linear gradient border: `rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3)` fading to `rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05)`.
- **Level 3 (Focused Overlays & Context Drawers)**: High-translucency `#161F33` layered over canvas blur. Soft, localized ambient glow: `0 0 24px -4px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15)`.
- **Status Luminescence**: Critical or active elements cast localized inner and outer glows using their respective accent tokens (e.g., `#10B981` at 15% opacity with an 8px spread for healthy GPU nodes).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Background `#00E5FF`, label `#0A0D14` (Inter bold or JetBrains Mono medium), radius 4px. Hover brings a `0 0 16px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5)` drop-glow with zero translation.
- **Secondary / Ghost**: Background `rgba(22, 31, 51, 0.6)` with a 1px border `#1E293B`, label `#E2E8F0`. Hover shifts border to `#00E5FF` and background to `#161F33`.
- **Destructive**: Background `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)`, 1px border `#EF4444`, label `#EF4444`.

### Chips & Status Badges
- Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) with a glassmorphic fill: `rgba(15, 20, 34, 0.75)` and a 1px border colored by state.
- **Healthy Node**: `#10B981` border with a 6px pulsing dot `#10B981` and JetBrains Mono small text.
- **Active Scaling / Workload In-Flight**: `#00E5FF` border with a spinning activity indicator.

### Input Fields & Terminal Consoles
- Background `#0F1422`, border 1px `#1E293B`, inset text `#F8FAFC`. Focus ring transitions to a crisp 1px `#00E5FF` accompanied by `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #00E5FF`.
- Integrated monospace command lines prefix user input with a muted cyan prompt symbol `$` and carry a solid blinking block cursor.

### Precision Data Grids & Lists
- Table headers use `label-caps` in JetBrains Mono (`#64748B`), separated by a clean 1px baseline `#1E293B`.
- Alternate row striping using `#0A0D14` and `#0F1422`. Hover on rows triggers an instant background switch to `#161F33` with an active 2px left border accent in `#00E5FF`.

### Cards & Cluster Nodes
- Constructed with surface `#0F1422` and fine borders (`#1E293B`).
- Headers feature segmented status lights, model architecture chips (e.g., `FP8`, `AWQ`, `TensorRT-LLM`), and live GPU VRAM / KV-cache capacity bars.
- Live metric graphs inside cards render with `#00E5FF` line paths backed by subtle vertical gradient fills that fade into the card background at zero opacity.

## Colors

The palette establishes an ultra-low light floor to reduce visual fatigue during prolonged incident management and node monitoring, layered with precision optical feedback.

### Palette Architecture
- **Obsidian Canvas Foundations**: Base surfaces sit at `#0A0D14` (canvas), `#0F1422` (primary panel surface), and `#161F33` (interactive surface/container elevated). Border lines and structural subdivisions utilize `#1E293B` and `#334155` at low opacity to maintain separation without visual weight.
- **Electric Cyan (`#00E5FF`)**: Primary action, active runtime telemetry, active routing traces, and primary node selectors. Communicates instantaneous throughput and active control.
- **Engine Emerald (`#10B981`)**: Operational healthy states, high availability metrics, cluster stability indicators, and optimal vLLM/TGI engine readiness.
- **Quantum Violet (`#6366F1`)**: Secondary infrastructure, queued inference requests, model checkpoint weights, and Kubernetes namespace abstractions.
- **System Diagnostics**:
  - Alert / Throttle Amber: `#F59E0B`
  - Critical Node Eviction / Pod OOM Red: `#EF4444`

Contrast ratios for text and key telemetry markers strictly conform to WCAG 2.1 AAA on all obsidian base layers.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy distinguishes narrative structure from diagnostic data:
- **Headings (Plus Jakarta Sans)**: Delivers geometric authority with clean architectural terminals. Used for section anchors, page titles, and cluster-level stats.
- **Interface & Prose (Inter)**: High legibility at small sizes, neutral rendering across standard rendering engines, optimized for rapid scanning in dense layouts.
- **Machine Data & Diagnostics (JetBrains Mono)**: Reserved for model weights, token latency (TTFT, ITL), pod statuses, YAML configurations, and command interfaces. Always rendered with tabular lining figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) to prevent jitter in live-streaming metric dashboards.

The layout is built around a flexible 12-column system optimized for dashboard density, telemetry sidecars, and split-screen code debugging.

- **Rhythm**: All paddings, row heights, and layout gaps adhere strictly to a 4px base increment (`0.25rem`), prioritizing dense vertical economy without crowding critical diagnostic metrics.

## Shapes

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system targets machine learning engineers, infrastructure architects, and deep-tech founders building high-performance AI systems. The aesthetic reflects structural precision, deterministic compute, and luminous clarity.

The visual direction combines **Precision Minimalism** with **Technical High-Contrast Utility**:
- **Purity over Noise:** Vast spans of crystalline white (`#ffffff`) and cool atmospheric light-gray layers (`#f8fafc`, `#f1f5f9`), avoiding heavy artificial textures.
- **Electric Accentuation:** Laser-focused cyan and sky-blue energy points represent active tensors, running endpoints, and low-latency inference channels.
- **Geek Elegance:** Strict alignment grids, monospaced computational metadata, tight hairline dividers (`#e2e8f0`), and unambiguous information hierarchy.
- **Emotional Intent:** Instill confidence, frictionless navigation through high-density telemetry, and an unyielding sense of modern algorithmic velocity.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is structured around an adaptive 12-column fluid grid tailored for heavy data throughput:

- **Desktop (≥1280px):** 12-column layout with fixed 260px collapsible operational side-navigation, 24px (`1.5rem`) gutters, and dynamic horizontal margins clamped to max 1600px width.
- **Tablet (768px – 1279px):** 8-column layout with 20px gutters, 24px outer margins, collapsing complex node graphs into stacked metric bands.
- **Mobile (<768px):** 4-column single-column prioritized flow with 16px (`1rem`) gutters and margins; data-heavy tables horizontal scroll with fixed left identity columns.

### Spatial Rhythm
- Apply `space-xs` (4px) and `space-sm` (8px) for internal atomic element grouping (e.g., metric label to value, tag internal offsets).
- Apply `space-md` (16px) for module card padding, form field vertical stacks, and icon-to-label distances.
- Apply `space-lg` (24px) for inter-card distances, table segment separation, and modal inner boundary gaps.
- Apply `space-xl` (40px) exclusively to major dashboard domain dividers and canvas hero boundaries.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system avoids blurry, heavy dropshadows, relying on **Structural Tiers, Hairline Boundaries, and Ambient Cyanic Diffusions**:

- **Tier 0 (Canvas Base):** Surface `#f8fafc`. Flat, non-elevated background.
- **Tier 1 (Surface Containers & Cards):** Surface `#ffffff` framed by a 1px solid `#e2e8f0` border. No shadow in resting state. Hover state transitions to border `#cbd5e1` accompanied by a micro-ambient illumination: `0 4px 20px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Tier 2 (Popovers, Flyouts, Menus):** Surface `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#e2e8f0`, shadow: `0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Tier 3 (Modals & Command Palette):** Backdropped by `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25)` with a `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)`. The surface is crisp `#ffffff`, edged with a precision 1px border `#cbd5e1`, with shadow: `0 20px 40px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12)`.
- **Active / Accent Glows:** Highlighted execution states use a directional luminous glow: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0284c7, 0 0 12px 0 rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#0284c7` background, text `#ffffff` (`Geist`, 14px, weight 500), border `1px solid #0284c7`. Hover transitions to `#0ea5e9`. Active transitions to `#0369a1`.
- **Secondary / Ghost Outline:** Background `#ffffff`, text `#0f172a`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`. Hover switches background to `#f8fafc` and border to `#cbd5e1`.
- **Ghost Action:** Background transparent, text `#334155`. Hover background `#f1f5f9`, text `#0f172a`.
- **Engineering / Terminal Action:** JetBrains Mono 12px font, height 32px, px-3, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`, with trailing keyboard shortcut chips (e.g., `⌘K`).

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Inputs:** Height 36px, background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`, text `#0f172a` (`Geist`, 14px). Placeholder color `#64748b`. Focused state applies `border-color: #0284c7` and a sharp ring `0 0 0 1px #0284c7`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios:** 16px square/circle, border `1.5px solid #cbd5e1`, background `#ffffff`. Selected state fills `#0284c7` with a crisp white tick mark.
- **Toggles / Switches:** 36x20px container with `#e2e8f0` background. Thumb is 16px white disk. Active state fills background with `#0284c7`.

### Chips & Telemetry Status Badges
- **Style:** JetBrains Mono 11px font, weight 500, uppercase letter-spacing 0.04em, padding `2px 8px`, radius 4px.
- **Live Running Indicator:** Background `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1)`, text `#0284c7`, border `1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3)` with an internal 6px pulsing dot.
- **Static Neutral Token:** Background `#f1f5f9`, text `#334155`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`.

### Data Cards & Clusters
- **Structure:** Background `#ffffff`, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, padding 20px, radius 8px.
- **Header Pattern:** Metric label in `Geist` 12px uppercase `#64748b`, primary value in `Space Grotesk` 24px `#0f172a`, accompanied by performance delta tags (`+12.4ms` or `-2.1%`).
- **Dividers:** Internal section partitions use 1px hairlines of `#f1f5f9`.

### Specialized Deep-Tech Components
- **Inference Log Viewer:** Background `#f8fafc`, font `JetBrains Mono` 12px, line numbers in `#64748b`, syntax colored via deep blue/slate shades and cyan string literals.
- **Model Topology Nodes:** Canvas elements rendered on pure `#ffffff` cards with active edge connections colored in `#06b6d4` with animating gradient dashes.

## Brand & Style

This design system targets machine learning engineers, infrastructure architects, and deep-tech founders building high-performance AI systems. The aesthetic reflects structural precision, deterministic compute, and luminous clarity.

The visual direction combines **Precision Minimalism** with **Technical High-Contrast Utility**:
- **Purity over Noise:** Vast spans of crystalline white (`#ffffff`) and cool atmospheric light-gray layers (`#f8fafc`, `#f1f5f9`), avoiding heavy artificial textures.
- **Electric Accentuation:** Laser-focused cyan and sky-blue energy points represent active tensors, running endpoints, and low-latency inference channels.
- **Geek Elegance:** Strict alignment grids, monospaced computational metadata, tight hairline dividers (`#e2e8f0`), and unambiguous information hierarchy.
- **Emotional Intent:** Instill confidence, frictionless navigation through high-density telemetry, and an unyielding sense of modern algorithmic velocity.

## Colors

The palette balances clean slate architecture with vibrant cyanic focal points:

### Base & Canvas Surfaces
- **Canvas Default:** `#ffffff` — Crisp, pure base for maximum contrast and high-definition clarity.
- **Canvas Subdued:** `#f8fafc` (Slate 50) — Used for foundational application backdrops, sidebar panels, and outer layout troughs.
- **Surface Elevated:** `#f1f5f9` (Slate 100) — Dedicated to interactive card foundations, table headers, and code block containers.
- **Border Default:** `#e2e8f0` (Slate 200) — Hairline boundaries, matrix lines, and divider structures.
- **Border Focus / Subtle Active:** `#cbd5e1` (Slate 300) — Interactive hover states on neutral containers.

### Typography & Content
- **Text Strong / Primary:** `#0f172a` (Slate 900) — Uncompromised high-contrast legibility for titles, critical metrics, and code operators.
- **Text Subdued / Secondary:** `#334155` (Slate 700) — Explanatory documentation, standard body descriptions, and secondary metadata.
- **Text Muted:** `#64748b` (Slate 500) — Placeholders, inactive labels, and table axis markers.

### Accents & Telemetry
- **Primary Accent:** `#0284c7` (Sky 600) — Main call-to-actions, active navigation pills, primary status highlights.
- **Secondary Accent:** `#06b6d4` (Cyan 500) — Telemetry pulses, throughput charts, model weights, and latency gauges.
- **Tertiary Accent:** `#0ea5e9` (Sky 500) — Interactive hover states, secondary highlights, and token stream indicators.
- **Subtle Accent Wash:** `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08)` — Active row selections, chip tints, and focused input backgrounds.
- **Status Semantic Signals:** Success `#059669` (Emerald 600), Warning `#d97706` (Amber 600), Critical `#e11d48` (Rose 600).

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy orchestrates technical capability and clean human readability:

- **Headlines (Space Grotesk):** Provides structured geometric confidence with subtle engineering idiosyncrasies. Used across major section titles, dashboard canvas metric headings, and system breadcrumbs.
- **Body & Editorial (Geist):** Serves as an unadorned, high-clarity sans-serif calibrated for dense functional dashboards, operational reports, and multi-column parameter tables.
- **Technical & Metric Metadata (JetBrains Mono):** Reserved for model identifiers, parameter counts (`70B`, `405B`), token generation speeds (`tok/sec`), memory allocation bars, timestamps, and JSON/YAML configuration previews.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is structured around an adaptive 12-column fluid grid tailored for heavy data throughput:

- **Desktop (≥1280px):** 12-column layout with fixed 260px collapsible operational side-navigation, 24px (`1.5rem`) gutters, and dynamic horizontal margins clamped to max 1600px width.
- **Tablet (768px – 1279px):** 8-column layout with 20px gutters, 24px outer margins, collapsing complex node graphs into stacked metric bands.
- **Mobile (<768px):** 4-column single-column prioritized flow with 16px (`1rem`) gutters and margins; data-heavy tables horizontal scroll with fixed left identity columns.

### Spatial Rhythm
- Apply `space-xs` (4px) and `space-sm` (8px) for internal atomic element grouping (e.g., metric label to value, tag internal offsets).
- Apply `space-md` (16px) for module card padding, form field vertical stacks, and icon-to-label distances.
- Apply `space-lg` (24px) for inter-card distances, table segment separation, and modal inner boundary gaps.
- Apply `space-xl` (40px) exclusively to major dashboard domain dividers and canvas hero boundaries.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system avoids blurry, heavy dropshadows, relying on **Structural Tiers, Hairline Boundaries, and Ambient Cyanic Diffusions**:

- **Tier 0 (Canvas Base):** Surface `#f8fafc`. Flat, non-elevated background.
- **Tier 1 (Surface Containers & Cards):** Surface `#ffffff` framed by a 1px solid `#e2e8f0` border. No shadow in resting state. Hover state transitions to border `#cbd5e1` accompanied by a micro-ambient illumination: `0 4px 20px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Tier 2 (Popovers, Flyouts, Menus):** Surface `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#e2e8f0`, shadow: `0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Tier 3 (Modals & Command Palette):** Backdropped by `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.25)` with a `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)`. The surface is crisp `#ffffff`, edged with a precision 1px border `#cbd5e1`, with shadow: `0 20px 40px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12)`.
- **Active / Accent Glows:** Highlighted execution states use a directional luminous glow: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0284c7, 0 0 12px 0 rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)`.

## Shapes

The geometric framework favors sharp architectural discipline over bubbly organic curves:

- **Base Radius (`rounded`, 4px):** Used for micro-components including badges, data table tags, status pills, inputs, and operational buttons.
- **Container Radius (`rounded-lg`, 8px):** Applied to telemetry cards, modular widgets, dropdown menus, and metric containers.
- **Structural Radius (`rounded-xl`, 12px):** Reserved solely for global modal dialogs, primary code IDE wrappers, and interactive node playgrounds.
- **Corner Contrast:** Inner sub-elements nested within containers must always use an inner radius calculated as `R_inner = max(0, R_outer - padding)` to maintain clean concentric geometry.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#0284c7` background, text `#ffffff` (`Geist`, 14px, weight 500), border `1px solid #0284c7`. Hover transitions to `#0ea5e9`. Active transitions to `#0369a1`.
- **Secondary / Ghost Outline:** Background `#ffffff`, text `#0f172a`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`. Hover switches background to `#f8fafc` and border to `#cbd5e1`.
- **Ghost Action:** Background transparent, text `#334155`. Hover background `#f1f5f9`, text `#0f172a`.
- **Engineering / Terminal Action:** JetBrains Mono 12px font, height 32px, px-3, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`, with trailing keyboard shortcut chips (e.g., `⌘K`).

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Inputs:** Height 36px, background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`, text `#0f172a` (`Geist`, 14px). Placeholder color `#64748b`. Focused state applies `border-color: #0284c7` and a sharp ring `0 0 0 1px #0284c7`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios:** 16px square/circle, border `1.5px solid #cbd5e1`, background `#ffffff`. Selected state fills `#0284c7` with a crisp white tick mark.
- **Toggles / Switches:** 36x20px container with `#e2e8f0` background. Thumb is 16px white disk. Active state fills background with `#0284c7`.

### Chips & Telemetry Status Badges
- **Style:** JetBrains Mono 11px font, weight 500, uppercase letter-spacing 0.04em, padding `2px 8px`, radius 4px.
- **Live Running Indicator:** Background `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1)`, text `#0284c7`, border `1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3)` with an internal 6px pulsing dot.
- **Static Neutral Token:** Background `#f1f5f9`, text `#334155`, border `1px solid #e2e8f0`.

### Data Cards & Clusters
- **Structure:** Background `#ffffff`, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, padding 20px, radius 8px.
- **Header Pattern:** Metric label in `Geist` 12px uppercase `#64748b`, primary value in `Space Grotesk` 24px `#0f172a`, accompanied by performance delta tags (`+12.4ms` or `-2.1%`).
- **Dividers:** Internal section partitions use 1px hairlines of `#f1f5f9`.

### Specialized Deep-Tech Components
- **Inference Log Viewer:** Background `#f8fafc`, font `JetBrains Mono` 12px, line numbers in `#64748b`, syntax colored via deep blue/slate shades and cyan string literals.
- **Model Topology Nodes:** Canvas elements rendered on pure `#ffffff` cards with active edge connections colored in `#06b6d4` with animating gradient dashes.
